remarks: Urban sophistication meets effortless living in this meticulously maintained 1BR/1BA residence on the 15th floor of THE BILTMORE - one of Stamford's premier full-service high-rises. This bright and inviting home offers sweeping downtown and sunset views through its expansive wall of windows, creating the perfect backdrop for both "chilling" and entertaining. The open living/dining area features engineered hardwood floors and an updated kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances, breakfast bar seating, and excellent storage. The bedroom includes a spacious walk-in closet and a updated double-entry full bath for added convenience. Enjoy the comfort of central air, abundant natural light, and your own new IN-UNIT WASHER/DRYER -- an uncommon luxury in this complex. Residents of The Biltmore enjoy 24-hour concierge service, a well-equipped fitness center, available FIBER OPTIC INTERNET, shuttle to Metro-North, elegant community room/lounge, unique 4th-floor landscaped courtyard, dry-cleaning services, and pet-friendly policy. Monthly and guest parking available at the adjoining parking lot (Propark). Perfectly positioned in the heart of Downtown Stamford, a short walk to Bedford and Summer Streets' vital dining and shopping area, Metro-North, and Pickleball America - a huge indoor venue. Also, easy access to I-95 and the Stamford Transportation Center. A superb opportunity to experience refined urban living with unbeatable convenience.
